## Context / immutable basis
At grouped-change parent `cbc02f0e591d4c6811bb1bfbd87885e62098198a`, the 17 selected unit modules contain exactly 29 editable prose blocks (25 leading docstrings and 4 full-line comment regions; 4,221 before-words). The historical audit used `d6669496cae441fc8381b5ee6de21a3993defd84`. Two selected module docstrings changed between those revisions. The 29 current-parent blocks and their stable anchors define this edit.

The `test_secret_screen_e7a9.py` executable source lookup also moved to `engine_dir()` before this work. This change retains that current code and edits only its selected comments. Current-parent spans and hashes are the before citations. Historical spans remain audit evidence.

## Editing boundary
Edit only the path-qualified IDs below plus adjacent blank-line normalization. `D:<owner>` is the leading `Expr(Constant(str))` of that exact owner. `C:<scope>:before:<anchor>` is one maximal full-line comment region in the innermost AST scope anchored to the next unchanged code prefix.

Retain immutable-before and final blobs. Parse both with `ast.parse(..., type_comments=True)`; remove only allowlisted leading docstrings on comparison copies, normalize only `ast.TypeIgnore.lineno`, and require every remaining AST equal. Tokenization must reject changed inline or non-allowlisted comments; directive text and attachment are separately exact.

## Protected material and contracts
Keep all 195 unlisted prose blocks, 12 inline comments, runtime strings, regexes, prompts, assertions, subprocess arguments, fixtures/test data, and 6 directive-bearing physical lines exact. In particular, secret fixtures/pattern strings and safe diagnostics remain runtime AST; concise runner capability assertions and the stall fixture’s wall-clock comment remain unlisted. No selected value is read via `__doc__`, `inspect.getdoc`, doctest, or pydoc.

Preserve: local-proxy bypass with real-gateway and opt-in exceptions; shared output-retry accounting and post-limit tool steering; running-loop offload, SDK premise, and ContextVar propagation; prompted schema visibility; primary-provider cache style with conservative hard-fail intersections and uncached fallback; active-only scans backed by archive folding; native-schema fallback and both provider/client rejection translations; standalone script-import portability; write-time secret rejection, detector/benign corpus, family-only logs, and reason-safe usage errors; nonblocking Serena reminder safety; pure settings mappings; loud-but-best-effort sidecar refusal; signing re-export/import/monkeypatch and 100–500 LOC boundaries; single helper definitions with behavior; blobless materialization without lazy fetch; immutable snapshot entries; throughput-based stall abort distinct from the configurable wall-clock ceiling. Pytest collects every owned module; focused verification includes `test_attestation_signing.py`, which consumes the signing patch seam.

## Independent review receipt
A non-author reviewer posts exactly 29 leaf-linked TSV rows:
`stable_block_id<TAB>before_citation<TAB>final_citation<TAB>preserved_contract_or_consumer<TAB>directives_exact<TAB>before_words<TAB>after_words<TAB>semantic-preservation<TAB>bloat-removal<TAB>reviewer_session`.
Before citations use full `cbc02f0e591d4c6811bb1bfbd87885e62098198a:<path>#<stable-id>`; final citations use the full final SHA. Each row has `after_words < before_words` and all three verdict fields equal `PASS`. Missing, duplicate, extra, author-reviewed, or non-PASS rows block closure.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Exactly 29 allowlisted blocks are shorter; no unlisted prose or executable/directive material changes.
- [ ] Path-specific immutable/final normalized ASTs and comment/directive guards pass on all 17 paths.
- [ ] One grouped commit changes exactly these 17 file-impact paths within the ticket scope with a clean scoped diff.
- [ ] Focused tests including the real signing consumer, comment hygiene, and untimed worktree-venv `make verify` pass.
- [ ] The independent TSV contains exactly 29 fully cited PASS rows.

## Verification
Run all seven structured DD commands: semantic, directives, paths, diff, focused, hygiene, and full.
